promptPattern.systemRole: Act as a senior QA Test Lead for a regulated digital payment service.
promptPattern.sourceOfTruth: Use ONLY the supplied BRD, user story, acceptance criteria, and interface contracts.
promptPattern.task: Generate positive, negative, regression, and edge test scenarios.
promptPattern.constraints: Do not invent requirements. Mark ambiguity as 'Clarification Required'. Separate Web and Mobile applicability.
promptPattern.output: Map each test to Build, User Story, AC, risk, preconditions, steps, and expected observable result.
promptPattern.validation: Identify coverage gaps, ungrounded assumptions, and items requiring human sign-off.

scenarios.title: 3DS Multilingual Guidance Prompt
scenarios.inputRequirement: AC-3DS-04: The 3DS challenge guidance displays in English or Simplified Chinese according to the traveller language selection.

weakPrompt.text: Write test cases for the 3DS language feature in English and Chinese.
weakPrompt.output:
TC-01: Verify English text shows on English page.
TC-02: Verify Chinese text shows on Chinese page.
weakPrompt.critique: Superficial coverage. Lacks negative paths, session persistence, language switching during active challenge, translation boundary validation, and traceability.

structuredPrompt.text:
SYSTEM: Senior QA Lead.
SOURCE: AC-3DS-04.
TASK: Decompose multilingual verification into positive, negative, and edge tests.
CONSTRAINTS: Explicitly test language switching mid-session, fallback when locale unsupported, persistence across redirect, and character truncation on mobile.
OUTPUT: Markdown table with Test ID, AC Tracing, Preconditions, Action, Observable Result, Risk Rating.

output.action: Select Simplified Chinese on Portal; initiate payment
output.expected: Issuer ACS iframe loads with approved simplified Chinese glyphs; font renders cleanly.

output.action: Switch browser locale to unsupported language (e.g. es-ES)
output.expected: System gracefully defaults to English with zero unrendered placeholder tags.

output.action: Change language on payment redirect return page
output.expected: Language selection persists across payment completion receipt without session loss.

output.action: View Chinese OTP guidance on 320px mobile viewport
output.expected: No character clipping, line-height >= 1.5, glyphs meet WCAG 1.4.12 spacing.

structuredPrompt.qaImpact: Coverage expanded from 2 superficial checks to 4 defensible risk-aligned test specifications.

scenarios.title: Payment Gateway Timeout & Recovery Prompt
scenarios.inputRequirement: AC-PAY-09: If payment gateway fails to respond within 15 seconds, the transaction status shall be marked as PENDING_RECONCILIATION and prevent immediate re-submission.

weakPrompt.text: Test what happens when payment times out.
weakPrompt.output: TC-01: Wait 15 seconds, check that error message appears.
weakPrompt.critique: Dangerous omission: Misses financial ledger state, duplicate charge prevention, asynchronous polling, and customer button disabling.

structuredPrompt.text:
SYSTEM: Senior QA Test Lead.
SOURCE: AC-PAY-09.
TASK: Generate rigorous state transition tests for payment gateway timeout.
CONSTRAINTS: Cover UI button debouncing, database transaction state, asynchronous inquiry job, and user retry prevention.
OUTPUT: Action, Expected System State, Ledger State, Risk Rating.

output.expected: Submit button disabled immediately on first click; duplicate POST requests suppressed.
Batch status set to PENDING_RECONCILIATION; locking token generated to prevent retry.

output.action: Reconciliation cron polls gateway 10 mins later and finds payment succeeded
output.expected: Batch automatically marked PAID; confirmation sent to traveller without manual ticket.

structuredPrompt.qaImpact: Prevents catastrophic double-billing defects in production.
